name: data-table-filter-command
title: Data Table Filter Command
description: A command palette input for the data table: type key:value filters with autocomplete, ranges and dates, keep a search history, and open it with a keyboard shortcut.
label: data-table-filters
author: OpenStatus <https://github.com/openstatusHQ>

props.name: schema
props.description: The filter schema from `createSchema(...).definition`; it parses and serializes what is typed.

props.name: tableId
props.description: Namespace for the search history in localStorage.

a11y: Built on cmdk: the input is a combobox, suggestions are a listbox, and the arrow keys move through them.
Cmd or Ctrl + K opens it from anywhere; Enter applies the query and Escape closes the list.
The closed state is a native button with the same visible text, so it is reachable with Tab.
The list does not pop in, and the loading spinner stays still, under prefers-reduced-motion.
